name: find_related_notes
description: Given an existing note file path, analyzes its semantic vector and discovers conceptually related notes in the Second Brain for smart cross-linking (Zettelkasten).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the note file (e.g. '/home/casimir/Documents/Segon_Cervell/Notes/20260817T082833--neteja-bloatware...org')

top_k.description: Number of related notes to discover (default: 4)
